title: hiPSC-CMs Freezing, Thawing, Recovery, and Regrowth Protocol
author: Yuichiro Ueda

steps.title: Prepare cryomedium
steps.instruction: Make a cryomedium consisting of 10 % (v/v) DMSO and 90 % (v/v) KSR; store fresh or at 4 °C for up to two weeks. Optionally benchmark side‑by‑side with (A) CryoStor CS10 (10 % DMSO, protein‑free) or (B) 7.5 % DMSO + 2.5 % trehalose (w/v) + 90 % KSR, keeping all other variables identical.

steps.title: Harvest cells for freezing
steps.instruction: Aspirate all old medium, wash twice with PBS(-) pre‑warmed to room temperature or 37 °C (≥200 µL / cm²). Add 10× TrypLE pre‑warmed to 37 °C (100 µL / cm²) and incubate on a shaker at 65 rpm, 25 mm throw for 4–7 min. Harvest cells between differentiation days 11–28 when spontaneous beating is stable.

steps.title: Optional pre‑freeze recovery (ROCKi)
steps.instruction: After dissociation and the first mild centrifugation (see step 12), resuspend cells in warm RPMI + B27 (37 °C) containing 10 µM Y‑27632 and incubate 1–2 h at 37 °C before adding cryomedium. If time‑critical, add ROCKi directly and proceed.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in cryomedium
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dissociated hiPSC‑CMs in the chosen cryomedium to a final density of 5–8 × 10⁶ cells / mL (avoid >10 × 10⁶ cells / mL unless validated).

steps.title: Aliquot cell suspension into cryovials
steps.instruction: Dispense 0.5 mL of the cell suspension into each 1.8–2 mL cryovial (do not exceed 0.5 mL).

steps.title: Load vials into VIA Freeze
steps.instruction: Place the prepared cryovials into the VIA Freeze system.

steps.title: Execute cooling cycle
steps.instruction: Program the VIA Freeze for a near‑linear cooling rate of –1 to –2 °C / min down to –100 °C (standard). For an advanced test, cool at –1 °C / min to –6 to –8 °C, apply controlled nucleation, then cool at 2–5 °C / min to –40 °C, followed by 5–10 °C / min to –100 °C.

steps.title: Transfer vials to LN2 storage
steps.instruction: When the temperature reaches –100 °C, move the cryovials on dry ice to the liquid‑nitrogen vapor phase for long‑term storage (minimum 24 h before thaw). If logistics allow, transfer directly from VIA Freeze to LN2 vapor phase, avoiding the dry‑ice intermediate.

steps.title: Optional dry‑ice transport
steps.instruction: If using dry ice, transport vials from LN2 to –79 °C dry ice for ≥30 min (20 min with lids on, 10 min with lids off). Ensure vials never exceed –50 °C during transfer.

steps.title: Thaw vials in 37 °C water bath
steps.instruction: Place cryovials in a 37 °C water bath for ≤2 min, swirling gently (no vortex). Remove when a small ice sliver (1–2 mm) remains.

steps.title: Dilute thawed cells into pre‑warmed medium
steps.instruction: Add the thawed suspension to at least 10× volume of pre‑warmed (37 °C, not RT) thawing medium: RPMI only + 10 µM Y‑27632. Example: 500 µL cells + 5 mL medium. Add slowly down the tube wall or use wide‑bore tips. Optional: include 25–50 mM trehalose or sucrose for the first 5–10 min to buffer osmotic shock; match osmolyte content if the cryomedium contained trehalose.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the diluted cells at 100 × g for 3 min (standard). If excessive loss in supernatant, test 150–200 × g for 2.5–3 min.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in replating medium
steps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant and add ≥2 mL pre‑warmed (37 °C) replate medium: RPMI + B27 + 10 % KSR + 10 µM ROCKi. Include blebbistatin if desired (see step 14). Use Geltrex or Matrigel coating (standard batch, 1.5–2× concentration optional).

steps.title: Optional blebbistatin addition
steps.instruction: Add 2.5–5 µM blebbistatin (or photostable analog) to the replating medium for the first 24 h post‑thaw to reduce contraction‑induced stress; remove at the Day 1 medium change. Keep plates protected from light.

steps.title: Gentle mixing of cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pipette the cell suspension gently 5–6 times with a 1000 µL tip.

steps.title: Prepare Trypan Blue viability assay
steps.instruction: Place 10 µL Trypan Blue in a well of a conical 96‑well plate. Add 10 µL of the well‑mixed cell suspension drop‑wise, then mix drop‑wise 3 times.

steps.title: Count cells and record metrics
steps.instruction: Load the mixture into a hemocytometer for the Countess 3. Record cell concentration (Mil/mL), viability (%), live and dead average diameters (µm), and calculate recovery rate (% live / frozen cells).

steps.title: Seed cells at desired density
steps.instruction: Plate cells at 50 000 cells / cm² (e.g., 480 k per well of a 6‑well plate) as standard; optimized range 80 000–120 000 cells / cm². After seeding, let plates sit ≥20 min at room temperature before moving to the incubator to allow even settling.

steps.title: Day 1 full medium change
steps.instruction: After 24 h, perform a complete medium change to remove residual DMSO.

steps.title: Day 3 and Day 6 maintenance
steps.instruction: Replace 50 % of the medium on days 3 and 6. For high seeding densities (>80 000 cells / cm²) or rapid color change, change 50 % daily from day 2–5, then resume every‑other‑day schedule from day 6 onward.

steps.title: Day 7 wash and dissociation for regrowth
steps.instruction: Wash wells twice with PBS(-). Add 10× TrypLE and incubate on a shaker at 65 rpm, 37 °C for 5–7 min.

steps.title: Collect cells and wash
steps.instruction: Using a 1000 µL tip, pipette 3–4 times per well to dislodge cells, collect into a 15 mL or 50 mL Falcon tube, then wash wells with 2 mL pre‑warmed RPMI (no supplements) and pool the wash into the same tube.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pooled cells at 100 × g for 3 min (RT or 4 °C).

steps.title: Resuspend for regrowth assay
steps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant and add ≥2 mL pre‑warmed (37 °C) replate medium (RPMI + B27 + 10 % KSR + 10 µM ROCKi).

steps.title: Gentle mixing (regrowth)
steps.instruction: Pipette gently 5–6 times with a 1000 µL tip.

steps.title: Prepare viability assay (regrowth)
steps.instruction: Repeat the Trypan Blue preparation: 10 µL Trypan Blue in a 96‑well plate, add 10 µL cell suspension drop‑wise, mix drop‑wise 3 times.

steps.title: Count regrowth cells and calculate rate
steps.instruction: Load into a hemocytometer for the Countess 3. Record counts, viability, live/dead diameters, and compute regrowth rate (% live / seeded cells).

steps.title: Optional second harvest for re‑freezing
steps.instruction: After regrowth, dissociate cells by gentle mixing (5–6 pipette actions with a 1000 µL tip), rinse wells with cold (4 °C) RPMI (≥200 µL / cm²), collect into 15 mL or 50 mL Falcon tubes, centrifuge at 100 × g for 3 min (RT or 4 °C), aspirate supernatant, and resuspend to 1–3 × 10⁶ cells / mL for counting or a new freeze cycle.

steps.title: Functional viability assessment (optional)
steps.instruction: In addition to Trypan Blue data, evaluate Day 7 regrowth by (1) spontaneous beating rate and beating area, (2) calcium transient amplitude/kinetics, (3) contractility/impedance (e.g., xCELLigence or CardioExcyte), and (4) MEA field‑potential parameters (frequency, FPD, conduction velocity) for MEA‑plated cultures.
